inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, Obsidian vault files, dashboard note, plugin config, CSS snippets, and plugin list

anchors.why: Identifies the repo as an Obsidian vault demonstrating the Dashboard++ method.
Single home dashboard with cssclasses, banner, sectioned navigation, inline Dataview recent/favorite/stats queries, and domain buckets.
Lists bundled plugin dependencies including Dataview, homepage, banners, and UI helpers.
Shows Dataview inline JS/query settings, refresh settings, and render behavior.
CSS class-based dashboard layout, bullet hiding, flex wrapping, full-width preview, and Dataview list support.

known_limits: This is a demonstration vault/template, not a knowledge review system.
Dataview and inline JS create useful live surfaces but are not evidence support.
Bundled plugins are runtime dependencies and should not be assumed safe for VAKS without separate plugin review.
